name: postluma
description: A mailbox that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers, Email Routing and D1. Use it as your own inbox or as a temporary-mail service for a few people.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Password for the first administrator, `admin`. After the first sign-in, change it in the app and delete this secret. 首个管理员 `admin` 的初始密码。第一次登录后在网页里改掉密码，再删除这个密钥。

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Site key of a [Turnstile widget](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) whose hostnames include the address you will open PostLuma at. It is public. [Turnstile 组件](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile)的 Site Key（公开），组件的主机名要包含 PostLuma 的访问地址。

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key of the same Turnstile widget. Without it nobody can sign in. 同一个 Turnstile 组件的 Secret Key，不填就没人能登录。
